parameters.name: Accessibility
parameters.description:
The accessibility:

- Public: Visible to all members.

- Private: Visible only to the creator.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The image name, used for fuzzy search.

parameters.name: Official
parameters.description: Specifies whether the image is an official image.

parameters.name: ProviderTypes
parameters.description: The list of image provider types.

parameters.name: SearchAll
parameters.description: Specifies whether to search all images.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The list of sort fields. You can sort by scheduled time, start time, and other fields. The format is "SortField+SortOrder(Desc/Asc)", where Asc is the default and can be omitted. Valid values of sort fields:

- CreateTime (Desc/Asc): The creation time.

- Name (Desc/Asc): The image name.
  Default value: CreateTime Asc.

parameters.name: Stages
parameters.description: The list of image publish stages to query.

parameters.name: Statuses
parameters.description: The list of image statuses to query.

parameters.name: SupportedTaskTypes
parameters.description: The list of supported task types.
